column3: Having something down from the head is rendered “with his head covered.”
The shaven woman is compared with a shaved head.
“As a covering” renders instead of a covering.
Coming together for the worse rather than the better is recast as doing more harm than good.
“Own” is supplied; “will not” renders the present do not praise.
BSB’s “this” with “cup” matches the Textus Receptus (τοῦτο).
The additional of the Lord after unworthily is not expressed; “sinning against” expands guilty of.
